name: Planet Fighter Transfer and Citadel Read Regression
description: Ownership, capacity, atomic fighter accounting, and treasury visibility for planetary APIs.

data.sql: INSERT INTO planets (planet_id, sector_id, name, owner_id, owner_type, class, type, created_by, population, colonists_unassigned, fighters, citadel_level) VALUES (977701, 1, 'Fighter Transfer QA', @{planet_fighter_owner_player_id}, 'player', 'M', 1, @{admin_player_id}, 0, 0, 50, 1) ON CONFLICT (planet_id) DO UPDATE SET owner_id=EXCLUDED.owner_id, owner_type='player', fighters=50, citadel_level=1;

INSERT INTO citadels (planet_id, level, treasury, owner_id, construction_status, target_level, construction_start_time, construction_end_time, planetaryShields, militaryReactionLevel, qCannonSector, qCannonAtmosphere) VALUES (977701, 1, 555, @{planet_fighter_owner_player_id}, 'idle', 0, 0, 0, 100, 1, 0, 0) ON CONFLICT (planet_id) DO UPDATE SET level=1, treasury=555, construction_status='idle', target_level=0, construction_start_time=0, construction_end_time=0, planetaryShields=100, militaryReactionLevel=1;
UPDATE players SET sector_id=1, lastplanet=977701 WHERE player_id=@{planet_fighter_owner_player_id};

tests.name: Land owner ship and set fighters

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET sector_id=1, onplanet=TRUE, fighters=100 WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id=@{planet_fighter_owner_player_id});

tests.name: Owner sees current citadel state, defenses, and treasury
Transfer fighters from ship to planet
Transfer fighters from planet to ship

data.sql: UPDATE ships s SET fighters=st.maxfighters FROM shiptypes st WHERE s.type_id=st.shiptypes_id AND s.ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id=@{planet_fighter_owner_player_id});

tests.name: Assert capacity refusal did not change fighter counts

data.sql: SELECT p.fighters=70 AND s.fighters=st.maxfighters FROM planets p JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id=@{planet_fighter_owner_player_id} JOIN ships s ON s.ship_id=pl.ship_id JOIN shiptypes st ON st.shiptypes_id=s.type_id WHERE p.planet_id=977701;
UPDATE ships SET fighters=0 WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id=@{planet_fighter_owner_player_id});

tests.name: Reject transfer exceeding available ship fighters

data.sql: SELECT p.fighters=70 AND s.fighters=0 FROM planets p JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id=@{planet_fighter_owner_player_id} JOIN ships s ON s.ship_id=pl.ship_id WHERE p.planet_id=977701;
UPDATE players SET sector_id=1, lastplanet=977701 WHERE player_id=@{planet_fighter_visitor_player_id};
UPDATE ships SET sector_id=1, onplanet=TRUE WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id=@{planet_fighter_visitor_player_id});

tests.name: Landed visitor does not receive treasury balance
Landed visitor cannot transfer planet fighters
